        std::cout << 12 << std::endl;
    } else if (maxDim % 2 == 0) {
        std::cout << minDim * maxDim << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << minDim * maxDim - (minDim * maxDim) % 2 << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
